implementation_constraints: read one JSON object from stdin, exit only via code (0 or 2) and stderr
fail-closed: block on invalid input, unprovable safety, uncertainty

unresolved_intent.rationale: spec requires recognising read-only tools by name but does not enumerate; chose intrinsically safe readers

unresolved_intent.decision: shell write indicators: redirection '>', in-place flags (-i,--in-place), pipes '|'
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec lists these as write patterns; conservative: any in a command mentioning the marker is a write
chose utilities that output to stdout only; excluded editors, writers, shells (and interpreters)

unresolved_intent.decision: recursive depth limit 50 for nested argument inspection
unresolved_intent.rationale: 'at any depth' vs infinite-recursion DoS risk; 50 is deep enough while guarding pathological inputs

unresolved_intent.decision: pipelines are blocked when the marker is mentioned, not parsed
unresolved_intent.rationale: full pipeline parsing equals execution, which is out of scope; conservative: block all pipes
